msg_run_cancelled: The calculation was cancelled. Nothing was written to the project.
msg_no_explicit_receivers: No explicit receivers have been placed. Use the map workspace to add receiver points before running.
msg_api_mode_reads_explicit_receivers: API mode reads explicit receivers from the backend project model, not the browser-only draft state.
msg_result_levels_unprojectable: The receiver levels are stored in {crs}, and this mode has no projection to put them on the map with.
msg_result_levels_failed: The receiver levels could not be projected onto the map.
msg_result_levels_unknown_crs: This run does not record which CRS its receiver coordinates are in, so they cannot be placed on the map.
msg_result_table_not_levels: None of this run's receiver indicators report decibels, so there is nothing for the noise ramp to paint.
error_load_result_levels: The results of this run could not be loaded.
msg_result_raster_not_grid: This run's receivers are not a grid, so there is no raster surface to paint.
msg_result_raster_no_band: The result raster holds no band named {indicator}, so it is not painted.
msg_result_raster_too_large: The result raster is {width}×{height} cells, larger than this browser can draw as one image. The receiver levels are still shown.
msg_result_raster_failed: The result raster could not be drawn.
msg_result_contours_failed: The contour lines could not be traced.
msg_result_run_unavailable: Run {runId} is not available here, so the newest completed run is shown.
confirm_delete_run_desc_exports_kept: Run {runId} and everything it wrote are removed from the project. Export bundles already generated from it are kept on disk. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_run_desc_exports_lost: Run {runId} is removed, together with its results, its log and any export bundle generated from it. This cannot be undone.
msg_delete_run_failed: The run could not be deleted.
confirm_discard_draft_desc: The unsaved work this browser kept is removed. It cannot be brought back.
confirm_delete_feature_desc: {kind} {id} is removed from the workspace. Undo brings it back until you leave the page.
confirm_delete_receiver_desc: Receiver {id} is removed from the workspace. Undo brings it back until you leave the page.

match.countPlural=one: The {count} imported object replaces everything the workspace holds — features, receivers and the calculation area. Add to workspace keeps them instead. The project on disk is unchanged until you save.
match.countPlural=other: The {count} imported objects replace everything the workspace holds — features, receivers and the calculation area. Add to workspace keeps them instead. The project on disk is unchanged until you save.

msg_ground_factor_hint: 0 for acoustically hard ground, 1 for porous ground. ISO 9613-2 resolves G per region from the zones a path crosses.
label_rail_water_body_fraction: Share of the path over water
action_apply_derived_source_type: Take the source type from the geometry
msg_field_range: Must be between {min} and {max}; not written.
msg_field_min: Must be at least {min}; not written.
msg_field_max: Must be at most {max}; not written.
msg_parking_section_note: An area source under RLS-19 is a car park. The parking area and its centroid come from the polygon and are not entered.
msg_parking_movements_required: Required unless a Table 7 facility type is given. Enter 0 explicitly for a period with no movements.
msg_parking_facility_seeds_rates: Seeds both movement rates from Table 7; a rate entered here wins for its own period.
msg_rail_section_note: Properties of the normative Annex 2 chain. The preview chain (rail_*) is not edited here.
msg_rail_arrays_read_only: Train types and track features are maintained in the model file; this editor only reports how many there are.
msg_rail_barrier_note: Applies where the wall reflects under Schall 03 or acts as a wide obstacle.
msg_rail_building_note: A building shields either way; reflection off its walls is opt-in.
msg_rail_reference_row: The table's reference row applies when this is not set.
msg_rail_reflecting_wall_opt_in: Raises levels for every model that never asked for it, so it stays opt-in.
msg_map_workspace_description: Import geometry, or draw the first feature directly on the map.
msg_no_project_yet_help: Import data to create the first project state, then return here to work with the map.
msg_project_intro: The current state of this project, and where to start.
dialog_desc_new_export: Export bundles are created via the CLI. Select a run and copy the command below.
dialog_desc_new_run: Configure standard, parameters, and receivers for this run.
tooltip_export_unavailable: This backend does not generate export bundles. Use the CLI command below.
msg_settings_appearance_help: Choose how the interface should look.
msg_settings_language_help: Choose the language used across the UI.
msg_settings_storage_help: Saved drafts live in localStorage and can be cleared here.

msg_settings_runtime_help: This page shows which frontend runtime mode is active.

settings_category_app_desc: Theme, language, storage, and runtime preferences.
settings_category_advanced_desc: Which backend this UI talks to, and diagnostics.
settings_category_map_desc: The basemap, its tile server, and the layer toggles.
msg_settings_basemap_help: Which rendering of the background map the model and the results are drawn over. All three draw the same tiles; only the treatment differs.
msg_settings_map_layers_help: Which layer groups the map draws. The switches are on the map itself; this is where anything hidden there can be shown again.
msg_settings_layers_note: Hidden layers are remembered in this browser, so they stay hidden after a reload. Resetting returns every group to its default.

msg_calc_area_active: Calculation area is set. Auto-grid will use this area instead of source extent.
evidence_tier_normative_desc: Normative: built on the published structure, coefficients and tables of the standard.
evidence_tier_preview_desc: Preview: the logic is sound, but it consumes preview-grade input levels. Check results before relying on them.
evidence_tier_scaffold_desc: Scaffold: no normative coefficients and invented base levels. Not usable for assessment.
evidence_tier_test_fixture_desc: Test fixture: an intentional, explicitly non-normative placeholder used for testing.
evidence_tier_unknown_desc: This build does not recognise the evidence tier reported for this standard.
msg_evidence_tier_scaffold_warning: This module is a scaffold: it carries no normative coefficients and its base levels are invented. Its output is not usable for assessment.
label_experimental_opt_in: I understand — run this scaffold standard anyway
msg_experimental_opt_in_help: The levels this run produces are not an implementation of the standard it names and must not be used for assessment.
tooltip_experimental_opt_in_required: Acknowledge the scaffold warning before starting this run.
msg_experimental_opt_in_required_error: The run was refused: this standard needs an explicit acknowledgement before it may emit levels.
dialog_desc_model_invalid: The project refused the model. Fix the findings below and save again.
msg_model_invalid_before_run: The model does not validate. A run against it would compute findings, not results.
msg_model_empty_before_run: There is nothing to calculate yet — import data or draw the first feature.

match.countPlural=one: {count} of these is already in the workspace. Adding keeps what is there and imports the rest.
match.countPlural=other: {count} of these are already in the workspace. Adding keeps what is there and imports the rest.

msg_import_skips_calc_area: The workspace already has a calculation area. Adding keeps the one that is there.
msg_import_nothing: There is nothing to import — the file holds no features, receivers or calculation area the model reads.
msg_import_errors_remain: These findings came in with the import and are in the model now.
error_map_load_timeout: The map did not finish loading. WebGL rendering may be blocked or unavailable in this browser.
error_map_webgl_unavailable: Map rendering is unavailable in this browser.
msg_map_crs_projecting: The model is stored in {crs}. It is being projected into WGS 84 for display.
msg_map_crs_unsupported: The model is stored in {crs} and no projection is available in this mode, so it cannot be drawn. A backend that can project it — the desktop or browser mode — shows it in place.
msg_map_crs_failed: The model stored in {crs} could not be projected for display: {reason}
msg_draw_disabled_no_projection: Drawing is disabled because the model is stored in {crs} and no projection is available in this mode. The map draws in WGS 84, and a drawn shape could not be moved into the coordinate system the model is stored in.
msg_draw_disabled_crs_unsupported: Drawing is disabled because the model's coordinate system {crs} could not be projected for the map. The map cannot draw the model, so it cannot place a new shape in it either — check the coordinate system the model was imported with.
msg_draw_disabled_projecting: Drawing is paused until the shape you just finished has been projected into {crs}.
msg_draw_projecting: The drawn shape is being projected into {crs}, the coordinate system the model is stored in.
msg_draw_projection_failed: The drawn shape could not be projected into {crs} and was discarded: {reason}
msg_bimschv16_area_category_absent: Not set = this receiver is skipped by the 16. BImSchV assessment; there is no default category.
msg_basemap_tiles_failed: The basemap tiles could not be loaded, so the map is drawn on a plain background. The model and the results are unaffected.
msg_basemap_tile_url_help: Raster tile template for the map basemap, with the usual z, x and y placeholders in curly braces. Leave it blank to use the OpenStreetMap default.
msg_basemap_tile_url_note: Stored locally in this browser only. A change takes effect the next time the map is built — open or reload the map page to pick it up.
msg_coordinate_entry_crs: Coordinates are read as {crs}, the coordinate system the model is stored in, and nothing is transformed. The readout at the bottom of the map gives the pointer in {crs} as well as in WGS 84, so a target can be read off the map.
msg_coordinate_entry_incomplete: Every X and Y has to be a number. A point needs one pair, a line two, an area three distinct corners — a repeated closing point does not count.
msg_feature_list_empty: Nothing in the model yet. Draw on the map, or enter coordinates.
msg_source_acoustics_reviewed: Marked as reviewed. The imported values are unchanged.

match.countPlural=one: {count} source will be marked as reviewed. The imported acoustic values are left as they are, and the whole step can be undone in one move.
match.countPlural=other: {count} sources will be marked as reviewed. The imported acoustic values are left as they are, and the whole step can be undone in one move.
